The Indian Women’s Hockey Team put up a determined performance against England in their final Pool D clash of the FIH Hockey World Cup Belgium & Netherlands 2026, playing out a hard-fought 0–0 draw in a closely contested encounter.
India showed immense resilience throughout the match, with Bichu Devi Kharibam producing a crucial save in the dying seconds to help India secure a valuable point and finish the Pool D stage with 5 points. The result also saw India book their place in the next phase of the tournament, keeping their semifinal hopes alive.
